demand_phase.ceo_summary: We're hardening the wireless stability of the wireless by automating the smoke tests to ensure our customers get a flawless experience.
demand_phase.cpo_summary: A streamlined, low-overhead utility that provides deterministic verification of network availability via structured logging.
demand_phase.rationale: The requirement specifies a headless CI verification utility with an HTTP echo server, which is best implemented as a lightweight command-line tool to be orchestrated by existing CI scripts.

stack_phase.build_notes: Integrate as a new target in the existing CMake build system; compile as a standalone CLI utility via build.bat; ensure structured logging outputs to stdout for CI capture.
stack_phase.cto_summary: A lean C++20 implementation using a lightweight socket wrapper is the only way to ensure this doesn't pollute the VRAM governor's headroom during smoke tests.
risks: Port contention in multi-tenant CI environments
Ensuring minimal footprint to avoid interference with system resources

user_brief: Headless CI verification brief extend repo smoke coverage with minimal HTTP echo server and structured logging
